name: National Energy System Operator Limited
notes: GB electricity system operator; designation effective 1 October 2024 (SRC-0001). Same company as ORG-0002, renamed (Companies House, SRC-0002). Runs the EAC auctions (SRC-0039) and the Single Markets Platform (SRC-0040). Named as CfD delivery body under its former name (SRC-0021).

name: National Grid Electricity System Operator Limited
notes: Registered name from 16 October 2017 until it was renamed on 1 October 2024 (Companies House 11014226). Kept so that older sources naming National Grid ESO resolve. Same registry_id as ORG-0001 because it is the same company.

name: Elexon Limited
notes: Administers the Balancing and Settlement Code (SRC-0019); appointed by Ofgem as flexibility market facilitator (SRC-0018). Registered as BSCC Limited from 13 July 1999 to 31 May 2000 (Companies House).

name: EMR Settlement Limited
notes: Wholly owned subsidiary of Elexon; EMR settlement services provider for LCCC (CfD) and for ESC (Capacity Market) (SRC-0020).

name: Low Carbon Contracts Company Ltd
notes: Counterparty to CfD contracts; a private company owned by DESNZ (SRC-0021). Registered as CfD Counterparty Company Limited until 29 April 2014 (Companies House). Website not opened in this run (403).

name: Electricity Settlements Company Ltd
notes: Capacity Market Settlement Body (SRC-0020). Parent and website not recorded: not confirmed from a primary source in this run.

name: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
notes: UK ministerial department (SRC-0024). Publishes the CfD and Capacity Market policy pages (SRC-0021, SRC-0022) and tasked Ofgem with the LDES cap and floor regime (SRC-0023). Creation date not recorded: not checked in this run.

name: Office of Gas and Electricity Markets
notes: Energy regulator for Great Britain; a non-ministerial government department (SRC-0025). Implements the LDES cap and floor regime (SRC-0023).

name: Energy Networks Association Limited
notes: Publisher of the Open Networks flexibility product reports (SRC-0028, SRC-0029). Company number from a Companies House search result. Website returns 403 to automated clients.

name: EPEX SPOT SE
notes: Power exchange registered in Paris under number 508 010 501 (SRC-0005). KEY_DATA spells it "EPEX Spot". Website not readable by automated clients in this run.

name: Nord Pool AS
notes: Owned by Euronext (66%) and TSO Holding (34%) (SRC-0006). Ofgem designated it as a GB NEMO in December 2015 under the name Nord Pool Spot AS, Norwegian company number 984 058 098 (SRC-0004); registry_id is left blank until the current registration is confirmed. Runs UK day-ahead and half-hour auctions (SRC-0007).

name: European Energy Exchange AG
notes: Exchange based in Leipzig, Germany; lists EEX GB Power Futures (SRC-0009). German commercial register number not checked.

name: ICE Futures Europe
notes: London derivatives exchange; lists UK Base Electricity futures (symbol UBL), which clear under the ICE Clear Europe Clearing Rules (SRC-0010). A private unlimited company (Companies House 01528617).

name: National Grid Electricity Distribution
